subject: Alaska
note: Cited to pinned Wikipedia revisions (trusted_secondary): Semisopochnoi Island and 180th meridian. 'Easternmost' is by longitude, as the island page words it.

claims.text: At 179°46' East, Semisopochnoi's easternmost tip is, by longitude, the easternmost land in the United States and North America.
Semisopochnoi is located 14 minutes (9.7 miles, 15.6 km) west of the 180th meridian.
The 180th meridian divides the planet into the Western and Eastern Hemispheres; the line runs through the Aleutian Island chain.
Semisopochnoi is uninhabited and supports well over a million seabirds.
Semisopochnoi is the largest subaerial volcano of the western Aleutians and contains a caldera 8 km wide.
